title: Shrink to Fit
description: A block on a grid is too large to fit through a narrow gap. Use resizing (shrink) to make it small enough to pass through and reach the goal tile.

title: Spin the Key
description: An L-shaped piece blocks a corridor. Rotate it with SPACE so it aligns with the passage, then move it to the goal.

title: Portal Hop
description: A single block sits on a grid with a wall in the middle. Step onto a teleport pad to warp to the other side and walk to the goal.

title: Buddy System
description: Two blocks move simultaneously with the same directional input. Cooperate their movement so both reach their own goal tiles at the same time.

title: Undo the Oops
description: Push a block toward the goal, but one wrong move sends it into a corner. Use undo to reverse the mistake and reroute to the goal.

title: Paint the Path
description: Move a block to the goal, but you can only step on white tiles. Press SPACE to recolor a blocked red tile to white before proceeding.

title: Stack and Cross
description: Two small blocks sit on opposite sides of a pit. Move them together to compose one larger block that bridges the gap, then cross to the goal.

title: Battery Run
description: Your block has 5 energy. Each step costs 1. Pick up a recharge cell on the grid to refill energy and reach a goal that's 8 steps away.

title: Shape Shift Gate
description: A gate only allows a flat horizontal shape through. Reshape your square block into a flat bar by pressing SPACE, then move through the gate to the goal.

title: Scale the Wall
description: A small block can't climb a 2-high ledge. Use scaling (grow taller) to make it tall enough to reach the upper platform and the goal.

title: Hidden Goal
description: The goal tile is invisible. Move your block around the grid; tiles you step on reveal whether the goal is nearby. Find and reach the hidden goal.

title: Dodge the Spike
description: A single spike patrols back and forth on a row. Time your directional moves to cross that row safely and reach the goal on the other side.

title: Exact Steps
description: Reach the goal in exactly 7 steps. The grid is open, so you must plan a path that uses precisely that count — no more, no less.

title: Click Switch
description: Two sprites sit on the grid — a circle and a square. Click to switch which one you control, then guide each to its matching goal tile.

title: Arrow Swap
description: Three colored sprites are in a row. Press left/right to cycle which sprite is active, then move the active one to the goal. Deliver all three.

title: Space Cycle
description: Your block can be red, blue, or green — press SPACE to cycle. A gate only opens for blue. Switch to blue, pass through, then reach the goal.

title: Setup Then Go
description: Phase 1: place a bridge tile on the grid by pressing SPACE at your chosen spot. Phase 2: press enter to lock in, then navigate your block across the bridge to the goal.

title: Remember the Code
description: First a 3-arrow sequence is shown on screen, then you asked to input that same sequence to open a gate and reach the goal.

title: Chase Escape
description: An adversary block mirrors your moves in reverse. Reach the goal before it catches you. The grid is small — plan a 5-move route carefully.

title: Overlap Order
description: Three tiles on the grid must be visited in a specific color order: red, green, blue. Step on them in sequence to unlock the goal tile.
